subject: Launching our mutual action plan — confirm champion, owners, and timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@orbihealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@orbihealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Launching our mutual action plan — confirm champion, owners, and timeline

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation. I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have a single source of truth for objectives, owners, and the close timeline. High-level goals we heard on the call:

- Validate model latency and throughput for OrbiHealth's real-time triage use case
- Confirm privacy & data residency approach for PHI-like telemetry
- Run a 6-week pilot to measure cost/unit and inference accuracy against your benchmarks

Proposed owners (please correct if wrong):
- Champion: Elena Park (OrbiHealth)
- AE / Redwood lead: Marissa Cole (me)
- Technical point: Tom Reynolds (OrbiHealth)
- Platform/ops contact: Karthik Iyer (Redwood)

Draft timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (May 17): Kickoff + environment access / credentials
- Week 1–2 (May 24–31): Tech deep-dive, baseline tests, perf tuning
- Week 3–6 (Jun 7–28): Pilot execution and weekly checkpoints
- Jul 1: Close decision / next steps (expand or iterate)

I've attached a one-page MAP draft and an evaluation checklist to this thread for your review (mutual_action_plan_draft_v1.xlsx, evaluation_criteria_v1.docx). Can you confirm the champion and owners, and whether the timeline looks reasonable on your side? If the dates are tight, we can shift the kickoff.

Next step on our end: I’ll update the MAP and send calendar invites once we land on a kickoff date.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0187

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet); evaluation_criteria_v1.docx (doc, checklists)
